What Sets Us Apart
Portland Veterinary Emergency and Specialty Care (PVESC) is a multi-specialty veterinary center. We have been serving Maine for more than thirty years. PVESC provides expert specialty and emergency care for your pet — and peace of mind for you.
Our Mission
We are dedicated to providing the highest standard of medical, surgical, and critical care for our patients.
Explore Our Locations
Top-Tier Clinical Care
30+ veterinarians, including specialists in internal medicine, oncology, neurology, and more, deliver cutting-edge care.
Meet Our Team
Serving Maine with Heart
Over 30 years of compassionate, personalized care for pets and their owners.
Our Story
“Fantastic, compassionate, understanding, caring, and professional team. I can't imagine a better emergency hospital experience and wouldn't bring either of my dogs anywhere else in the Portland area for another situation like this.”
Ceren P.
“Provided compassionate care and kept me updated through the process. The front desk staff, vet techs, and veterinarians were all absolutely wonderful!”
Liz C.
“I've brought several dogs to PVESC over the years. The depth and breadth of experience in treating patients requiring specialist care is unmatched. I wholeheartedly recommend PVESC to anyone requiring specialist veterinary care.”
Scott S.
“We've consistently had positive experiences here with our dog Nimbus. The staff are always kind, competent and compassionate, and every time we have left truly feeling that the care we received was the best possible for the scenario.”
Megan B.
“PVESC was incredible. They were compassionate, communicative, patient, and did such a great job taking care of my cat. I cannot recommend them enough. I will only be going here in the future for emergency pet needs.”
Eliza K.
“The entire staff at Portland Veterinary Emergency Hospital are kind and very empathetic. I highly recommend this hospital.”
Susan K.
“The emergency vet is a life saver. The staff is very knowledgeable and I felt that everyone was doing the best that they could at all times. Everyone was very caring and poised.”
Daneel D.
